tables.td: p-3.5 text-sm text-slate-200 border-b border-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors

a4_print_job_sheet.strategy: Light paper styling via standard @media print rules while retaining dark app UI
print_css_rules: @media print { body { background: #ffffff !important; color: #000000 !important; } .no-print { display: none !important; } .print-only { display: block !important; } .print-page { max-width: 100% !important; margin: 0 !important; padding: 20px !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: none !important; } }

interactive_states_and_a11y.buttons: Always define explicit hover and focus states with focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50 outline-none
interactive_states_and_a11y.inputs: bg-slate-950/80 border-slate-800 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-600 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-sm
interactive_states_and_a11y.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, status toggles, tabs, search boxes, modals) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute e.g. data-testid='create-job-wedding-submit-button'

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.file_type: Remember that React code files in this project use .js and .jsx extensions (JavaScript), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.no_ai_slop: Do not use plain unstyled boxes or center-aligned full app containers. Maintain structured dashboard layout with top headers and sidebar.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. Avoid AI assistant emojis like 🤖 or 💡.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.toasts: Use 'sonner' for all success and error toasts (located at components/ui/sonner.jsx).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.live_calculation: All form inputs for Card Cost, Printing Cost, Discount, Advance, Quantity MUST calculate Total and Balance instantly without requiring manual submit.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.testing: Ensure data-testid attributes are present on every key action element across Dashboard, Wedding Form, Other Printing Form, Work Management, Reports, Recycle Bin, and Settings.
